Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
9:01 AM

National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Today, Tue 27 Oct, it is open until 6:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card. Tickets can be booked online at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. This comes from the museum's own Plan Your Visit page. Check its holiday calendar before you go, since closures on national holidays can change.
